## Case 1: 清單 / 空狀態: Verify that with no todos the list, the outstanding counter, and the filter links are not visible

```yaml
requirement_ids: [FR-TODO-01]
priority: High
test_type: UI
```

**Severity:** Major

### Preconditions

- 開啟 app 前沒有任何已儲存的 todo(全新瀏覽器環境,或已清除先前儲存的資料)

### Test Steps

| Step | Action | Expected Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 開啟 app 的根路徑(#/) | 頁面載入完成;清單區看不到任何 todo;footer 的未完成計數看不到;All / Active / Completed 三個篩選連結都看不到 |

### Notes

來源:PRD §4.1 FR-TODO-01 / 規格段落 No todos。本案例不對「全部標記完成」checkbox 是否顯示做斷言,規格未定義(見 open questions)。

## Case 10: 清單 / 編輯儲存(Enter): Verify that pressing Enter in edit mode saves the modified title and exits edit mode

```yaml
requirement_ids: [FR-TODO-10]
priority: High
test_type: Functional
```

**Severity:** Major

### Preconditions

- 清單有 1 項 todo "Buy milk"
- 該項已雙擊進入編輯模式,輸入框內容為 "Buy milk" 且已取得焦點

### Test Steps

| Step | Action | Expected Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 在編輯輸入框把標題改為 "Buy milk and eggs" 後按 Enter | 該項標題更新為 "Buy milk and eggs";離開編輯模式:編輯輸入框消失,該項的 checkbox 與移除按鈕恢復顯示(移除按鈕依滑鼠位置) |

### Notes

來源:PRD §4.1 FR-TODO-10 / 規格段落 Editing。v0.3 將 Enter 與失焦拆為兩條 requirement。

## Case 11: 清單 / 編輯儲存(失焦): Verify that blurring the edit input saves the modified title and exits edit mode

```yaml
requirement_ids: [FR-TODO-11]
priority: High
test_type: Functional
```

**Severity:** Major

### Preconditions

- 清單有 1 項 todo "Buy milk"
- 該項已雙擊進入編輯模式,輸入框內容為 "Buy milk" 且已取得焦點

### Test Steps

| Step | Action | Expected Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 在編輯輸入框把標題改為 "Buy milk and eggs" | 輸入框內容顯示為 "Buy milk and eggs",尚未離開編輯模式 |
| 2 | 讓編輯輸入框失焦(點擊頁面上其他非該項的空白處) | 該項標題更新為 "Buy milk and eggs";離開編輯模式:編輯輸入框消失,該項的 checkbox 恢復顯示 |

### Notes

來源:PRD §4.1 FR-TODO-11 / 規格段落 Editing。

## Case 12: 清單 / 清空標題即刪除: Verify that clearing the title in edit mode deletes the todo, both on Enter and on blur

```yaml
requirement_ids: [FR-TODO-12]
priority: High
test_type: Functional
```

**Severity:** Major

### Preconditions

- 清單有 1 項 todo "Buy milk"
- 該項已雙擊進入編輯模式,輸入框內容為 "Buy milk"

### Test Steps

| Step | Action | Expected Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 清空編輯輸入框的內容,按 Enter | 該項 todo 從清單中被刪除,清單不再包含 "Buy milk",並離開編輯模式 |

### Notes

來源:PRD §4.1 FR-TODO-12 / 規格段落 Editing。規格同時列出 Enter 與失焦兩種觸發且未拆成兩條 requirement,故以 Enter 為代表值;失焦觸發的刪除結果相同。

## Case 13: 清單 / 取消編輯: Verify that pressing Escape in edit mode discards the change and exits edit mode keeping the original title

```yaml
requirement_ids: [FR-TODO-13]
priority: High
test_type: Functional
```

**Severity:** Major

### Preconditions

## Case 14: Footer / 未完成計數: Verify that the footer counter shows the outstanding todo count with correct singular/plural text and updates on add and on check/uncheck

```yaml
requirement_ids: [FR-TODO-14]
priority: High
test_type: Functional
```

**Severity:** Major

### Preconditions

- 清單為空(尚未新增任何 todo)

### Test Steps

| Step | Action | Expected Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 新增 1 項 todo "Buy milk" | footer 計數顯示 "1 item" |
| 2 | 再新增 1 項 todo "Walk the dog" | footer 計數顯示 "2 items" |
| 3 | 勾選其中一項的 checkbox | footer 計數更新為 "1 item" |
| 4 | 勾選另一項的 checkbox,使所有項目都完成 | footer 計數更新為 "0 items" |
| 5 | 取消勾選其中一項的 checkbox | footer 計數更新為 "1 item" |

### Notes

來源:PRD §4.1 FR-TODO-14、§6 訊息文案清單 / 規格段落 Counter。文案須逐字比對:0 items、1 item、2 items。計數是否只算目前篩選可見項目規格未定義(見 open questions)。
human_reason: 字串應該是 item left, PRD 有誤導致 test case 跟著出錯

## Case 15: Footer / 清除已完成: Verify that Clear completed removes all completed items and clears the mark-all-as-complete checked state

```yaml
requirement_ids: [FR-TODO-15]
priority: High
test_type: Functional
```

**Severity:** Major

### Preconditions

- 清單有 3 項 todo:"Buy milk"、"Walk the dog" 已完成,"Read book" 未完成

### Test Steps

| Step | Action | Expected Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 按 footer 的「清除已完成」 | 已完成的 "Buy milk" 與 "Walk the dog" 從清單移除;清單只剩 "Read book" 且仍為未完成樣式;「全部標記完成」呈未勾選 |
| 2 | 勾選「全部標記完成」使 "Read book" 完成,再按「清除已完成」 | "Read book" 從清單移除,清單不再有任何項目;「全部標記完成」不再呈勾選狀態 |

### Notes

來源:PRD §4.1 FR-TODO-15 / 規格段落 Clear completed button + Mark all as complete。清單清空後「全部標記完成」是否仍顯示,規格未定義(見 open questions);本案例只斷言其不再呈勾選。

## Case 16: Footer / 清除已完成按鈕顯示: Verify that Clear completed is hidden when there are no completed items

```yaml
requirement_ids: [FR-TODO-16]
priority: Medium
test_type: UI
```

**Severity:** Minor

### Preconditions

- 清單有兩項未完成 todo:"Buy milk"、"Walk the dog",沒有任何已完成項目

### Test Steps

| Step | Action | Expected Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 檢視 footer 區域 | 看不到「清除已完成」按鈕 |
| 2 | 勾選 "Buy milk" 的 checkbox 使其成為已完成 | 「清除已完成」按鈕出現 |

### Notes

來源:PRD §4.1 FR-TODO-16 / 規格段落 Clear completed button。第二個步驟驗證同一條規則的另一個狀態(FR-TODO-15 以「有已完成項目時按下」為前提)。

## Case 17: 持久化 / 清單內容: Verify that todo content and completion state survive a page reload and that no item is left in edit mode

```yaml
requirement_ids: [FR-TODO-17]
priority: High
test_type: DataPersistence
```

**Severity:** Critical

### Preconditions

- 清單有兩項 todo:"Buy milk"(已完成)、"Walk the dog"(未完成)

### Test Steps

| Step | Action | Expected Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 新增第 3 項 todo "Read book" | 清單共 3 項,新項目為最後一項 |
| 2 | 雙擊 "Read book" 標題進入編輯模式,改為 "Read a book" 後按 Enter | 第 3 項標題更新為 "Read a book",離開編輯模式 |
| 3 | 重新載入頁面 | 清單仍為 3 項,標題與排序與重新載入前一致(含 "Read a book");完成狀態與重新載入前一致:只有 "Buy milk" 為已完成;沒有任何項目處於編輯模式(未出現編輯輸入框) |

### Notes

來源:PRD §4.1 FR-TODO-17 / 規格段落 Persistence。儲存機制(key 格式、localStorage)依 PRD §7、§10 不列為斷言值。

## Case 18: 篩選 / 預設顯示全部: Verify that the default view shows all todos with the All link selected, and that clicking All shows all todos again

```yaml
requirement_ids: [FR-TODO-18]
priority: High
test_type: Functional
```

**Severity:** Major

| 2 | 依序點擊 footer 的 "Active" 連結,再點擊 "All" 連結 | 清單再次同時顯示 "Buy milk" 與 "Walk the dog";"All" 連結呈選取狀態 |

### Notes

來源:PRD §4.1 FR-TODO-18 / 規格段落 Routing。依 v0.3 修正,動作為點擊 footer 連結;hash(#/)僅為背景,不作為斷言值。

## Case 2: 新增 todo / 載入焦點: Verify that on page load the new-todo input already holds focus so the user can type immediately

```yaml
requirement_ids: [FR-TODO-02]
```

## Case 21: 篩選 / 篩選中改動立即反映: Verify that completing an item in the Active filter and un-completing an item in the Completed filter remove it from the visible list immediately

```yaml
requirement_ids: [FR-TODO-21]
priority: High
test_type: Functional
```

**Severity:** Major

### Preconditions

- 清單有兩項未完成 todo:"Buy milk"、"Walk the dog"
- 已點擊 footer 的 "Active" 連結,清單顯示兩項未完成項目

### Test Steps

| Step | Action | Expected Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 勾選 "Buy milk" 的 checkbox | "Buy milk" 立即從清單消失,清單只剩 "Walk the dog"(不需重新載入或再次點擊篩選) |
| 2 | 點擊 footer 的 "Completed" 連結,再取消勾選 "Buy milk" 的 checkbox | "Buy milk" 立即從 Completed 清單消失,清單不再顯示任何項目 |

### Notes

來源:PRD §4.1 FR-TODO-21 / 規格段落 Routing。此要求在 Active 與 Completed 兩個篩選下各有一段動作,屬同一條 requirement 的兩個觸發,故合為一案例。

## Case 22: 篩選 / 重新載入後保留: Verify that an active filter survives a page reload with the same link selected and the same filtered list

```yaml
requirement_ids: [FR-TODO-22]
priority: High
test_type: DataPersistence
```

**Severity:** Major

### Preconditions

- 清單有兩項 todo:"Buy milk"(已完成)、"Walk the dog"(未完成)
- 已點擊 footer 的 "Active" 連結

### Test Steps

| Step | Action | Expected Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 在 "Active" 篩選下重新載入頁面 | 頁面載入後仍停在 Active 篩選:"Active" 連結呈選取狀態,清單只顯示未完成的 "Walk the dog",已完成的 "Buy milk" 不出現 |

### Notes

來源:PRD §4.1 FR-TODO-22 / 規格段落 Routing。PRD 只要求驗證停在 Active 或 Completed 其一即可,本案例以 Active 為代表值;Completed 的行為相同。

## Case 3: 新增 todo: Verify that entering text and pressing Enter appends the item as the last item and clears the input

```yaml
requirement_ids: [FR-TODO-03]
priority: High
test_type: Functional
```

**Severity:** Critical

### Preconditions

| 2 | 在新增輸入框輸入 "Walk the dog" 後按 Enter | 清單共有兩項,"Walk the dog" 排在 "Buy milk" 之後(成為最後一項);新增輸入框內容再次被清空 |

### Notes

來源:PRD §4.1 FR-TODO-03 / 規格段落 New todo。排序僅斷言「新項目為最後一項」,其餘排序規則見 open questions。

## Case 4: 新增 todo / 空白輸入: Verify that whitespace-only input does not create a new todo

```yaml
requirement_ids: [FR-TODO-04]
priority: High
test_type: Validation
```

### Notes

來源:PRD §4.1 FR-TODO-04 / 規格段落 New todo。規格只規定 trim 後為空不成案,未規定空白被拒絕後輸入框內容是否保留,故不對輸入框內容斷言(見 open questions)。

## Case 6: 清單 / 全部標記完成: Verify that the mark-all-as-complete control toggles every todo to completed and back to active

```yaml
requirement_ids: [FR-TODO-06]
priority: High
test_type: Functional
```

```yaml
requirement_ids: [FR-TODO-07]

test_type: Functional
```

**Severity:** Major

### Preconditions

- 清單有兩項未完成 todo:"Buy milk"、"Walk the dog"
